name: vi-speech
title: Vietnamese speech
summary: Speaks a Vietnamese text in one of 25 preset voices and writes one audio file on this machine. English words inside a Vietnamese text also work. It runs on the CPU and needs no GPU.
good_for: Vietnamese narration of a short or long text, up to 4,000 characters
A Vietnamese voice for a script, a demo or a notification
A Vietnamese text that has a few English words in it
not_good_for: A voice that copies the voice of a person
A text with a [tag] that is not one of the 3 allowed tags

text.how_to_write: The text is the whole input. horus adds no words and removes no words. Write the words as people say them, with the Vietnamese tone marks. Write numbers and abbreviations as words if you want to control how the model says them. Use only the 3 tags in tags, as in 'Xin chào [cười] tôi là Hải Đăng.'
rules: Write the text in Vietnamese with all tone marks. A word without tone marks gets a wrong tone.
Use only these tags: [cười], [thở dài], [hắng giọng]. The model reads any other [tag] aloud, so horus refuses it.
Write a number or an abbreviation as words when you need an exact reading.
Check the transcript in the result against your text. The model does not give the same audio for the same text two times, so the transcript changes from call to call.

A small difference is normal, and the audio can be right with it. The speech recognition model writes some words with another tone or another letter that sounds almost the same, for example 'lối' for 'lỗi' or 'giữ' for 'dữ'.

The share of wrong words is the words of your text that are not in the transcript, divided by the words of your text. In 240 measured files of short sentences, it was 0 in 133 files and at most 0.294 (about 3 words in 10).
A share above 0.344 is outside the measured spread: treat the file as wrong and call generate_speech again. The transcript of another sentence gives a share of 0.846 or more.

examples.text: Xin chào, tôi là Hải Đăng. Hôm nay chúng ta sẽ nói về hàng đợi tin nhắn.
Máy chủ báo lỗi, tôi thử lại. [thở dài] Vẫn lỗi.

timing.hardware: AMD Ryzen 7 4800H, CPU only, Windows 11. 5.2 to 8.2 s for a sentence of 3 to 6 s of audio. 272 s for a text of 3,999 characters (210 s of audio).
timing.note: The first call after horus mcp starts also loads the models: 4.1 to 6.5 s when the model files are in the disk cache of the OS. One process with the models uses 1,973 MB at the peak for a short text and 5,255 MB for a text of 3,999 characters.
